newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank lifts after nine-month results.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank lifts after nine-month results.

text.p: Shares in Bayerische Vereinsbank came off early lows in pre-bourse trade, but were as almost as weak as the rest of the market, after the bank's nine month results were met with mixed reactions.
BayernVerein shares were off 35 pfennigs, or 0.62 percent, at 55.90 marks. The IBIS DAX was off 0.68 percent, or 18.25 points at 2663.69.
The bank said group operating profit after provisions were one billion marks for the first nine months to September 30, up 17.5 percent.
Analysts had forecast the bank would report operating profits of 990 million marks to 1.09 billion marks, after the bank reported a 24 percent rise in profit at the half-year stage.

Analysts at Suedwest LB said the results had been slightly below their expections, while others said the share would be supported after the bank said its shareholders should profit from its projected 10 percent improvement in 1996 earnings.
Also positive for the stock, they said, is talk that Deutsche Bank AG wants to up its stake in the bank.
